title: Understanding the Exponential Regularization Function
text: The regularization function is defined as Pow(theta)=lambda*sum{i=1}{p}{10**theta_i}. As lambda increases, the regularization term becomes more significant in the optimization problem.

title: Effect of Large Lambda on Theta
text: Consider what happens to the value of $${10}^{\theta_i}$$ as $$\theta_i$$ becomes very negative. How does this affect the regularization term?

title: Minimizing the Regularization Term
text: To minimize the regularization term, the values of $$\theta_i$$ should be adjusted such that $${10}^{\theta_i}$$ is minimized. What happens to $${10}^{\theta_i}$$ as $$\theta_i$$ approaches negative $$\infty$$?

title: Conclusion on Optimal Theta
text: Based on the behavior of $${10}^{\theta_i}$$ as $$\theta_i$$ approaches negative $$\infty$$, what can we conclude about the entries of the optimal hat{theta} vector as lambda approaches positive $$\infty$$?
